cases.name: an asset's src is a relative path — a scheme, a leading `/` or a `\` is media-src-not-relative, and that file is not opened
a cut's gain is decibels with the unit — anything else is media-gain-invalid
a prompt's projection of a block already being expanded contributes nothing — the recorded hash is of `a  b`, so nothing is stale
every time is at most max-time, and so is where a cut ends — media-time-out-of-range
an interaction that only verifies may end up apart-tolerance apart, and no further — media-interaction-apart
an asset's current value is its file's SHA-256, not its declared `sha256` — the entry that made the bytes it has now is the one judged (§6)
an asset whose file is not there has no current value: no entry is judged, and it is no orphan (§6)
when no entry matches the current value the asset is an orphan, and nothing about it is stale (§6)
an input's current value is its file's SHA-256, and hashes compare without regard to case (§6)
an asset with no `sha256` is `media-asset-unhashed` whether or not its file is there (§3)
